entries.title: Usage's Projects and Kinds menus are solid and close when you click away
entries.body: In Settings, Usage, the Projects and Kinds menus under Cost per task no longer show the chart through them or open on top of each other. A click anywhere else, or moving on with Tab, closes the open menu, and a small down arrow replaces the triangle that looked like a play button.

picture.alt: Cost per task in Settings, Usage, with the Kinds menu open as a solid panel over the readouts and the line, and a down arrow on each filter
